external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.
external_entities.notes: Users sign in with an email address and password and receive a session cookie. No second factor is used.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and uses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in to the admin console with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, payers, support agents, and the PDF workflow.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app applies the company filter to each database query. It is not stated whether it checks invoice company ownership or rechecks user roles when requests arrive.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console is reachable only from the support office network.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that takes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by the render job.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security, and the app connects with one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state how the queue is reached or protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket holding rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. The text does not state how the bucket is reached or protected at rest.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Customer user signs in to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.data_description: Email address and password; session cookie is returned.

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: Customer user opens an invoice in the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app checks that the invoice belongs to the user's company.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected by invoice number.

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: Customer user submits an invoice edit to the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.notes: The billing app saves every field it receives, including the paid flag and the company's payout bank account.
data_flows.data_description: Whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account.

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: Customer user asks the billing app to generate a PDF of an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.
data_flows.data_description: Request identifying an invoice.

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: Payer opens the payment page and receives the invoice and company payment details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details.

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: Billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number.

data_flows.name: query and save
data_flows.description: Billing app reads and saves tenant data in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, and invoice updates.

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: Billing app places a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: PDF renderer takes a render job from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected by company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF under company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: Billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code.

data_flows.name: open session
data_flows.description: Admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and subsequent agent actions.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary containing the customer users associated with that company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform where the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and from which the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.basis: The source states that the database stores every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
